hadith:
Conditions - Narrated `Uqba bin Amir:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "From among all the conditions which you have to fulfill, the conditions which make it legal for you to have sexual relations (i.e. the marriage contract) have the greatest right to be fulfilled."
message:
Here is a spiritually uplifting message based on the provided sources:

Remember that Allah, the Reliever, expands provision and mercy for those who fulfill their sacred obligations with sincerity—beginning with honoring the marriage contract, which holds the greatest rights among all conditions. Though wrongdoers may face hidden punishments they are unaware of, those who walk the path of righteousness trust in Allah's abundant blessings and boundless care for His creation.
name:
Al Baasit - الْبَاسِطُ - The Reliever

The name Al Baasit originates from the Arabic root word 'b-s-t', which conveys the concept of spreading or expanding. In Islamic tradition, it reflects Allah’s role in providing for His creation and ensuring that resources, both spiritual and material, are sufficiently available. This name highlights the boundless nature of Allah's provision and mercy.
verse:
At-Tur - The Mount - 52:47

Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know.
